propositions: A reconcile pass with an invisible or decommissioned mapped project key must abort at preflight before any Jira mutation, with an actionable error naming the offending key.
legacy_default and the configured query_project fallback (when projects is empty) must be validated in the preflight alongside mapped project keys.

The preflight must probe bot-visible projects via AcliClient._direct_rest_get against GET /rest/api/3/project/search endpoint with pagination, failing closed on transport errors or page-cap exhaustion.

The preflight must only run for mutating passes (skipping preview/dry-run/reconcile-check) and only when the configured backend is 'jira'; other backends and missing _direct_rest_get must be observable and skip without error.
A preflight failure must return an OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult with an observable log/stderr message, never crash the pass consumer, and never call reconcile_once.
